ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows three separate circular glass containers, labeled SO2, CH4, and NCl3, respectively. The question stem states that each container has 10.0 g of gas, the three containers have the same volume, and the temperature is all maintained at 298 K. According to the ideal gas equation PV = nRT, under conditions where R, T, and V are all the same, pressure P is directly proportional to the amount of substance n. Compare the amounts of substance of 10.0 g of each gas: the molar mass of SO2 is about 64.1 g/mol, the molar mass of CH4 is about 16.0 g/mol, and the molar mass of NCl3 is about 120.4 g/mol. Under the same mass, the smaller the molar mass, the greater the amount of substance; CH4 has the smallest molar mass, so 10.0 g CH4 contains the most moles. Therefore, the pressure in the CH4 container is the greatest.

raw_record.question_text: 10.0 g each of three different gases, SO2, CH4, and NCl3, are placed in separate glass containers of identical volume. The temperature of all three flasks is held constant at 298 K. Which gas would have the greatest pressure?

method.method_draft: From the image, identify the three gases in separate containers: SO2, CH4, and NCl3. From the text, note that each gas has mass 10.0 g, the containers have identical volume, and all are at 298 K. Use PV = nRT to reduce the comparison to P ∝ n because R, T, and V are the same. Calculate or compare molar masses; CH4 has the lowest molar mass, so 10.0 g of CH4 contains the most moles. Therefore the CH4 flask has the greatest pressure.
method.CoT_raw: 图像中显示了三个分开的圆形玻璃容器，标签分别为 SO2、CH4 和 NCl3。题干说明每个容器中各有 10.0 g 气体，三个容器体积相同，并且温度都保持在 298 K。根据理想气体方程 PV = nRT，在 R、T、V 都相同的条件下，压力 P 与物质的量 n 成正比。比较 10.0 g 各气体的物质的量：SO2 的摩尔质量约为 64.1 g/mol，CH4 的摩尔质量约为 16.0 g/mol，NCl3 的摩尔质量约为 120.4 g/mol。相同质量下，摩尔质量越小，物质的量越多；CH4 的摩尔质量最小，所以 10.0 g CH4 含有最多的摩尔数。因此 CH4 容器中的压力最大。
